maps.label: Maps

openDataPage.title: Open data, map sources and delay logic
openDataPage.description: This page summarizes the public and derived datasets used by the rail twin. The layout is optimized for mobile reading and quick scanning.

maps.label: Base maps
maps.detail: OpenStreetMap is used for base geography. CARTO tiles power the standard and dark map views, while Esri World Imagery powers satellite mode.

timetable.label: Timetable data
timetable.detail: Passenger timetable structure, stop order and station calling patterns are aligned with publicly available rail schedule information.

thailand.label: Thailand open data
thailand.detail: Station names, rail locations and supporting geography are assembled from Thai public datasets and openly available geographic sources.

delay.label: Delay deviations
delay.detail: Delay and early-running indicators are derived by comparing live train movement against the published timetable and expected stop timing.

dark.label: Night map
dark.detail: OpenStreetMap contributors + CARTO Dark Matter tiles

notesList.refresh: Map attributions on the main map update automatically when the user changes theme.
notesList.estimates: Some operational fields are inferred from the latest movement frame when no direct public timestamp is available.
notesList.coverage: Coverage may vary by route, train type and station depending on source completeness.
notesList.feedback: If you have questions about data sources, delay logic, would like to suggest improvements or you believe your data has been used and you would like to be credited, please submit a change in the repository at https://github.com/andreybotkin/railtwin; the updated data will appear on this site in the next release.
notesList.official: This service is not affiliated with or endorsed by the State Railway of Thailand (SRT) or any official railway operator. Data is sourced from publicly available information and derived estimates, and may not reflect real-time conditions or operational decisions.

footer.dataSource: Data source: State Railway of Thailand (SRT)

cookiesBanner.label: Cookies
cookiesBanner.message: Used for language, map state and analytics.

privacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicyPage.description: This page is optimized for mobile reading and summarizes how rthfi.com may process technical, usage and location-related information.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: rthfi.com provides a web interface for viewing railway map layers, station data, train movement and supporting operational context. This Privacy Policy explains what information may be processed when you use the service.

informationProcessed.title: Information We Process
informationProcessed.body: We may process basic technical data such as browser type, device characteristics, IP-derived diagnostics and aggregate usage analytics. If you tap the locate button on the map, your browser may share your approximate device location only for that interactive session.

howWeUseInformation.title: How We Use Information
howWeUseInformation.body: Information is used to render the map, improve performance, understand feature usage, troubleshoot errors and support service reliability. Location access is used solely to center the map around your current position when you explicitly request it.

cookiesAndAnalytics.title: Cookies and Analytics
cookiesAndAnalytics.body: The service may use essential browser storage for map state, interface preferences and analytics tooling. These technologies help preserve your map viewport, support product measurement and identify reliability issues.

sharingAndRetention.title: Sharing and Retention
sharingAndRetention.body: We do not sell personal information. Data may be processed by infrastructure, analytics or map providers that support the application. Logs and diagnostics are retained only as long as reasonably needed for security, operations and product maintenance.

yourChoices.title: Your Choices
yourChoices.body: You may decline browser location access, limit analytics through your browser settings or stop using the service at any time. If you believe your data has been used and you would like to be credited, please submit a change in the repository at https://github.com/andreybotkin/railtwin; the updated data will appear on this site in the next release. If you have questions about privacy handling for this deployment, contact the operator responsible for the instance you are using.

policyUpdates.title: Policy Updates
policyUpdates.body: This policy may be updated as the product evolves, additional data sources are connected or legal requirements change. Continued use of the service after updates means the revised policy applies from its published date.

termsOfServicePage.title: Terms of Service
termsOfServicePage.description: These terms explain the conditions for using rthfi.com, including service limitations, acceptable use and data-related disclaimers.

acceptanceOfTerms.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptanceOfTerms.body: By accessing or using rthfi.com, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the service. These terms apply to interactive map views, schedule screens, operational overlays and related pages.

serviceDescription.title: Service Description
serviceDescription.body: rthfi.com presents railway-related data, visualizations and estimates for informational purposes. Features may include map layers, station metadata, train movement, schedule comparisons and derived delay indicators.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.body: You agree not to misuse the platform, interfere with its operation, scrape it abusively, reverse engineer restricted systems, attempt unauthorized access or use the service for unlawful, deceptive or harmful purposes.

operationalDisclaimer.title: Operational Disclaimer
operationalDisclaimer.body: The service is not an official dispatching, signaling or safety system. Train positions, schedules and delay calculations may be incomplete, delayed or estimated. Do not rely on rthfi.com as the sole source for safety-critical or time-critical decisions.

availabilityAndChanges.title: Availability and Changes
availabilityAndChanges.body: Features, interfaces, datasets and endpoints may change, pause or be removed without notice. We may update, suspend or limit access to all or part of the service to maintain quality, security or legal compliance.

intellectualPropertyAndDataRights.title: Intellectual Property and Data Rights
intellectualPropertyAndDataRights.body: Underlying software, branding, interface design and non-public implementation details remain protected. Third-party datasets, basemaps and imagery remain subject to their own licenses, attributions and usage terms. If you believe your data has been used and you would like to be credited, please submit a change in the repository at https://github.com/andreybotkin/railtwin; the updated data will appear on this site in the next release.

limitationOfLiability.title: Limitation of Liability
limitationOfLiability.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the service is provided on an as-is and as-available basis without warranties of uninterrupted availability, complete accuracy or fitness for a particular purpose. The operators are not liable for losses resulting from use or inability to use the service.

updatesToTheseTerms.title: Updates to These Terms
updatesToTheseTerms.body: We may revise these terms from time to time. Continued use of the service after an update means you accept the revised version as of its published date.
